title: Open Subsurface Data record, version 1
description: One dataset as published by its owner. Facts about the dataset, never facts produced by our tools: verification levels, checksums and outlines live in build output, not here.

id.description: publisher-slug/dataset-slug; stable forever, also the file path records/<id>.yaml

summary.description: Two or three sentences in the publisher's own terms.

url.description: The page a person opens to get the data. Never a deep link that expires.

access.description: anonymous: a download needs no account; registration: a free account; api: a documented service; request: a human approves

manifest_url.description: Optional machine-readable listing of files (index, API, bucket listing) the verifier can checksum against.

name.description: The licence as the publisher names it.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier when one exists (CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, OGL-UK-3.0, NLOD-2.0); null for bespoke licences.

redistribution.description: May a third party host a copy? Decides whether the mirror store may hold this dataset.

share_alike.description: Derived products must carry the same licence (CC BY-SA and kin).

statement.description: The attribution line a derived product must carry, verbatim when the publisher prescribes one.

kinds.description: What the dataset holds, in the vocabulary of the Ophiolite kind registry (E55) where it overlaps; source-list marks a page that lists other datasets.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 decimal degrees, approximate, for the map's first zoom only.

crs.description: The dataset's own CRS as the publisher states it, e.g. EPSG:23031.

stated.description: As the publisher states it, e.g. '~5 TB including seismic'.

listed_by.description: Where we found it; seg-wiki means https://wiki.seg.org/wiki/Open_data

osdu.description: Identifiers in the OSDU reference data where the same dataset is carried.
